scope: Targeted primary-source mechanism audit; sufficient to motivate a bounded diagnostic, not a systematic priority or novelty certification.
potential_distinction: Test hard predicted-class frequency contrasts and preserve transformation/class identity before cross-validator order statistics, on the exact quorum-admitted aggregate. The factorial diagnostic must establish an incremental effect beyond probability-based independent maxima.

sources.title: CrowdGuard: Federated Backdoor Detection in Federated Learning
sources.overlap: Private-client feedback, behavioral hidden-layer analysis, pruning and vote aggregation already exist.
sources.difference_to_test: Output-label transformation-specific cross-validator order statistic on the deployed aggregate rather than hidden-layer pruning of individual models. This is a positioning hypothesis, not proof of priority.

sources.title: Backdoor Defense in Federated Learning Using Differential Testing and Outlier Detection
sources.overlap: Prediction-based differential testing and robust MAD outlier filtering are established.
sources.difference_to_test: Fixed aligned spatial challenges on disjoint private validators, a common normalized aggregate and hard-class contrasts, rather than optimizing shared validation inputs to separate local-model clusters.

sources.title: Towards a Defense against Backdoor Attacks in Continual Federated Learning
sources.overlap: Cumulative backdoor leakage and the insufficiency of partial per-round filtering are established.
sources.difference_to_test: An absolute aggregate behavior gate; no parallel shadow model or target-label early stopping. Do not claim discovery of persistence.

sources.title: FLShield: A Validation Based Federated Learning Framework to Defend Against Poisoning Attacks
sources.overlap: Validation using private participant data and robustness under heterogeneous access are established. Prior repository audits cover representative models and class-wise loss impact.
sources.difference_to_test: Label-change alignment across shared transformations on a final aggregate, rather than representative-model class-wise clean-loss validation.

sources.title: BackdoorIndicator: Leveraging OOD Data for Proactive Backdoor Detection in Federated Learning
sources.difference_to_test: No injected indicator training task or central OOD dataset; finite local perturbation evaluation only.

submission_requirements: Show a specific scoring effect with matched examples, panels and training, not merely a combination of existing defenses.
Audit additional recent related work and reproduce the closest baselines before claiming novelty or superiority.
Independent confirmation, unseen triggers and defense-aware attacks remain outside this development authorization.
